summary: Full end-to-end validation of the procurement workflow (backend + frontend). Backend pytest: 10/10 PASS covering SM create with bifurcation mismatch (submission succeeds), Admin sees SM notes+pi_amount+items, Admin clarify -> pending_clarification, SM resubmit-pi reopens as pending_admin with fresh pi_file, Admin approve routes to pending_management when a Management user is assigned, Mgmt approve -> approved, Accounts POST /po (po_number+note+file) -> po_issued with accounts_note persisted, tax-invoice upload persists tax_invoice_file, milestones create+pay -> paid (paid_amount=161200), and GET /api/files/{id}/download returns 200 for freshly uploaded PI v2 / PO / Tax files. Frontend Playwright: SM creates PI with intentional bifurcation mismatch and the proc-bif-hint shows delta text 'under PI amount by ₹10,000 (you can still submit)' AND submit succeeds (row appears). Admin Review dialog shows review-sm-notes with SM note, PI amount, and both items. Admin clarify triggers pending_clarification and SM sees resubmit-<request_id> 'Upload new PI' button. ResubmitDialog shows resubmit-ask-note with Admin's clarification note, prefills items, accepts new PI file + revised items + pi_amount, and reopens the request. Admin approve routes to Management (mgmt-review button visible for the Management user). Mgmt approve -> Accounts issues PO via po-submit with po-note + po-tax-file. Documents column renders pi-link/po-link/tax-link testids; tax-invoice download URL (embedded token) returns HTTP 200 both with Bearer header and via href token param. Accounts note + PO number render in the row detail. StageTrack progresses correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: There is no admin delete endpoint for a procurement request. If a request is created in error there's no supported way to remove it via API — currently required a direct Mongo delete to clean up test artefacts. Consider adding DELETE /api/procurement/{id} for admin or a soft-cancel action.

Procurement.jsx (line 200-203): bifOff logic is `items.length > 1 && Math.abs(itemsSum - piAmt) >= 1`. If a user has a SINGLE item whose extended cost != pi_amount, no soft warning is shown at all. Consider dropping the >1 guard so single-item PIs also surface the mismatch hint (still non-blocking).
